title: Projects
subtitle: Group an organization's follow-ups and track them to the deadline.

detail.caption: Assignations of {{name}}
detail.none: This project has no assignations yet. Edit it to add the organization's follow-ups.

legend.title: What the states mean
legend.pending: Nobody has started its follow-ups yet.
legend.review: A follow-up is complete and waits for your review.
legend.correction: Some answers were sent back and are being corrected.
legend.approved: Every follow-up is complete and approved.
legend.overdue: A follow-up passed its deadline before being completed.
legend.empty: The project has no assignations yet.

delete.title: Delete this project?
delete.body: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its assignations and their answers are kept; they just stop belonging to a project.

edit.title: Edit project
edit.name: Name
edit.deadlineHint: You can move the deadline, but not remove it.
edit.assignationsHint: The organization's follow-ups that are not in another project.
edit.noAvailable: This organization has no follow-ups available for the project.

errors.deadlineRequired: Choose a deadline for the project

empty.noneBody: A project groups an organization's follow-ups with one deadline, so you can see at a glance what to review and what is late.
empty.filteredBody: No project matches this tab and search.
